lower_level_source: Verified regular close of November 4, 2026, shared by historical sources and current provider previousClose metadata. It is not a proven support or a breakout resistance.
lower_level_purpose: Keep price confirmation above the last completed daily close. A stable reference known before today, not a moving intraday threshold.
S_type: Manual initial protection retained; no tightened stop to manufacture reward/risk.
signal: First eligible future completed regular 15-minute close strictly above 65.78 and at or below 67.50, with daily structure and thesis intact. A cross from below, green candle, extraordinary volume or ideal-zone visit is not required.
activation_rule: Register a complete future regular 15-minute interval after independent approval and final communication, before the interval starts. No partly observed or prior bar is eligible.
execution_validity: DAY, regular session; no additional fixed 15-minute expiry after the signal. Current price and all conditions must still be valid at order time. A valid signal is not permission to leave an unattended order.
pre_signal: Before a signal, price at or below 65.78 does not authorize buying; a later qualifying future close may be considered while structure remains intact. A new trade above 67.50 after this review suspends buying until a brief, documented current reassessment of price, thesis, structure and risk, and registration of a new future observation window. Returning into range alone is not sufficient and no whole-day veto or full new DCF is automatically required. A regular trade below M 61.55 ends the proposal.
pre_signal_M_breach: Regular trade strictly below 61.55 ends the proposal.
after_signal: First subsequent trade at or below 65.78, above 67.50, thesis/structure change, unresolved order conflict or session expiry ends the unfilled initial opportunity and requires manual cancellation/verification of any remainder. No automatic rearm.
after_fill: Confirmed shares follow manual S 61.20 and canonical Stage 4. Neither 65.78 nor M 61.55 becomes an additional intraday stop on a filled position. The original R and campaign budgets are not reset.
limit_order: Hypothetical regular-session DAY limit no higher than 67.50, only after valid signal and account checks. A limit order may fill below the lower band during a fall before cancellation succeeds.
existing_CTSH_position_and_orders: Unknown. This is an initial-entry proposal only if absence of an existing campaign and of live/uncertain orders is verified. If a fill already occurred, do not open another initial tranche; reconcile lots and remaining budgets.
method_change: Only a proposed revision of discretionary execution choices within canonical B: stable prior-close level instead of 66.40 intraday rounding, and default DAY validity instead of an extra 15-minute countdown. No statistical advantage has been established. This does not change the canonical plan.
market_risk_note: Broad index declines observed at 13:32 EST increase slippage and failed-signal risk; no automatic macro veto. DAY validity still requires active monitoring and current conditions.
